entities.summary: Lieutenant Leone Nakarawa is a Fijian rugby union footballer and Olympic gold medalist. He plays as a lock for Castres and represents the Fijian national team in international rugby. He previously played for Glasgow Warriors and is Warrior No. 224. He won the Pro12 with the Glasgow Warriors in 2014–15 and re-signed with the club in 2020. Inbetween that period, he played for Racing 92. In 2018 he was awarded the EPCR Player of the Year accolade.
